title: Ericsson wins Red Dot Award for brand design evolution
summary: Ericsson has been named a winner of the Red Dot Award 2026 in the Corporate Design and Identity category for its brand design evolution, developed in partnership with Valtech RADON. The award recognizes how Ericsson’s visual identity now comes to life across corporate, digital and customer-facing channels.
